intro.title: Gold and Silver Chains
intro.descriptionHtml: Popular range of enchanting supreme quality gold and silver chains in versatile patterns. Extensive collection of linked chains in Cuban, twisted, box, curb, snake, wheat and beads pattern which are available in varying thickness and weight. Ranging from simple light weight chains to heavy ones, these Chains are perfect for wearing with Rudraksha/ Lockets/Pendants.
